open_points.question: Which module owns refusing a well-formed port below 1, as required by A8?
options: `runtime_settings` refuses ports below 1, while `deliverer_service` refuses ports above `MAX_PORT`
`deliverer_service` refuses every well-formed port outside 1 through `MAX_PORT`
open_points.default_guess: `runtime_settings` refuses a well-formed port below 1, while `deliverer_service` refuses one above `MAX_PORT`.

witness.initial: `PORTAL_DELIVERER_PORT` is `0`, and every other required setting and start-up resource is valid.
events: `deliverer_service` performs the start-up checks and attempts to listen.
outcomes: The start ends because `runtime_settings` treats a value below 1 as invalid.
The value passes because it has the right integer form and is not above `MAX_PORT`, so the service proceeds to the server with port 0.
witness.observer: The operator sees either a start failure or a service that proceeds to bind an operating-system-selected port.
